name: Castañar de Ibor (Spain)
description: Square green flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Castañar de Ibor (a chestnut tree on yellow above waves).
history: The arms and the flag of Castañar de Ibor were approved by the Order of 19 February 1990 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 1 March 1990, after the municipal council's approval on 24 June 1989; the flag is defined officially as square and green, bearing the municipal arms in its colours at its centre.

features.role: Castañar de Ibor arms — chestnut tree above waves
